reviews.shade: [Upgraded] ongredients Skin Barrier Calming Lotion EX 220ml Set (+80ml)
reviews.text: The lotion feels lightweight and moisturizing on my skin. It spreads easily and leaves my skin feeling soft and comfortable. I like having a product that helps keep my skin hydrated without feeling too greasy. A nice addition to my daily skincare routine.
reviews.zh: 呢款乳液搽喺皮膚上好輕盈，有保濕效果。好容易推開，令皮膚感覺柔軟舒適。我好鍾意有啲產品能夠保持皮膚水潤，又唔會覺得太油膩。係我日常護膚嘅好好加分項目。

reviews.shade: [Upgraded] ongredients Skin Barrier Calming Lotion EX 220ml Set (+80ml)
reviews.text: I had great expectations for this product, but I think it is just a very average lotion.
reviews.zh: 我對呢件產品期望好大，但係我覺得佢只係一款非常普通嘅乳液。

reviews.shade: [Upgraded] ongredients Skin Barrier Calming Lotion EX 220ml Set (+80ml)
reviews.text: this lotion was a big surprise, it is super lightweight and even watery however it absorbs so fast and leaves my skin hydrated. i have dry skin and i wanted something light for summer and this totaly works,
reviews.zh: 呢款乳液好出乎意料，質地超輕盈，甚至有啲水感，不過吸收好快，令皮膚保持水潤。我皮膚乾，想夏天用啲輕盈嘅產品，呢款完全啱用。

reviews.shade: [Upgraded] ongredients Skin Barrier Calming Lotion EX 220ml Set (+80ml)
reviews.text: I love it, after you apply it on the skin it gives such a refreshing feeling that calms the skin, also it doesn't have any greasy feeling so it's really good
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意，搽喺皮膚上之後會有好清爽嘅感覺，有助令皮膚平靜，而且冇油膩感，所以真係好好。

reviews.shade: [Upgraded] ongredients Skin Barrier Calming Lotion EX 220ml Set (+80ml)
reviews.text: Liked much better the original version of a lotion (without the words EX). The EX version (this product) a bit lighter, and I need to apply it twice, because it's dries too fast on my skin before applying makeup. If you have only this version, it's ok too.
reviews.zh: 我更鍾意原版嘅乳液（冇 EX 字樣嗰款）。EX 版本（即係呢件產品）比較清淡，我要搽兩次，因為化妝之前佢喺我皮膚上乾得太快。如果你淨係有呢個版本，都可以接受。

reviews.shade: [Upgraded] ongredients Skin Barrier Calming Lotion EX 220ml Set (+80ml)
reviews.text: love this ongredients skin barrier calming lotion, it has a rich liquid texture that is very special. It absorbs so well into the skin and doesn't pill at all when layered with other products or makeup.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢款 ongredients skin barrier calming lotion，佢質地好豐富、好似液體咁，好特別。非常易吸收入皮膚，同其他產品或者化妝品疊埋一齊用都完全唔會搓泥。

reviews.shade: [Upgraded] ongredients Skin Barrier Calming Lotion EX 220ml Set (+80ml)
reviews.text: It's nice and moisturising, leaves a glow on the skin even under another cream. It's very light, so for dry skin you'd need at thicker cream on top of it. Not sure if I'd buy it again.
reviews.zh: 保濕效果幾好，即使喺另一款面霜底下，皮膚都會有光澤。佢好輕，所以如果係乾性皮膚，就需要喺上面再加一款厚啲嘅面霜。唔肯定我會唔會再買。

reviews.shade: [Upgraded] ongredients Skin Barrier Calming Lotion EX 220ml Set (+80ml)
reviews.text: this is one on the best base prep, especially for oily skin. this also helped repair my broken skin barrier so quickly. I love it and will definitely be repurchasing
reviews.zh: 呢款係其中一款最好嘅打底前基礎護理，特別係油性皮膚。佢仲好快幫我修復咗受損嘅皮膚屏障。我好鍾意，一定會回購

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
